title: Application of deep learning upon spinal radiographs to predict progression in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis at first clinic visit
summary: A self-attentive capsule network analyzed first-visit spinal radiographs to classify adolescent idiopathic scoliosis progression. In a retrospective cohort, the model reached 76.6% accuracy on an independent test set and was also checked on a separate imaging platform; this does not establish prospective treatment benefit.
